title: Historically grounded project-diagnosis expansion
description: Cross-language comparison over eight multi-file regressions, including four synthetic adaptations of independently sourced public issue mechanisms.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-repository success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check repository success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict efficiency/reliability parity.

maintainability_gate.root_cause: All 48 Parley assignments must modify the task/language defect file frozen in predeclared_analysis.root_cause_files.
maintainability_gate.caller_compensation: A hidden-correct patch that does not modify the predeclared defect file fails root-cause quality and remains fully reported.
maintainability_gate.overall_verdict: A general maintainable-parity pilot requires both strict primary parity and the Parley root-cause condition.

source_protocol.editable_files: Twenty-four language-specific seeded implementation files across eight repositories.
source_protocol.read_only_files: Sixteen language-neutral ISSUE.md and tests/regression.txt artifacts, visibly marked read-only and byte-identical across languages.
source_protocol.public_examples: Protected by the checker and omitted from every agent prompt; diagnosis comes from source and read-only project evidence.
source_protocol.protected_files: Checker, source printer, configuration, prompt, provenance, public/hidden cases, and attempt log are never agent-readable and remain integrity-hashed.

historical_grounding.adapted_mechanism: unknown configuration input discards recognized valid settings
response alias prevents id-based cache normalization
rollback rewinds position without clearing termination state
fresh cancellation context loses lock authority needed for rollback

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.

The first four task objects are exactly preserved from iteration 028; the four additions, independent oracles, source seeds, evidence, hidden cases, provenance, and root-defect mappings were committed before protocol freeze or any measured session.
Historical grounding applies to bug mechanisms only. The fixtures are synthetic deterministic adaptations and copy no upstream source.
Read-only context is byte-identical across languages; implementation syntax and ordinary standard-library setup remain language-specific.
Root-cause location is a predeclared maintainability judgment separate from hidden-output correctness.
Changed-file count and rough-token edit size are secondary metrics, not substitutes for hidden correctness, the four-condition gate, or root-cause quality.
secondary_analysis: Report every session, repository outcome, repair, token count, elapsed time, prompt size, editable-source size, read-only-context size, edit size, changed-file count, integrity result, and command-protocol result.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by unrelated repository and independent session.
Report root-cause file modification by language, task, and session; show every caller-side compensation without altering hidden correctness.
Compare the complete primary medians with repair-free sensitivity only if at least two Parley sessions pass all eight repositories on their first check.
Inspect recurring diagnosis or language failures only after preserving the full result; a single task, transcript, or session cannot justify a compiler or skill change.
feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155 with the exact 1,519-character skill. Iteration 029 changes only the preregistered diagnosis corpus and root-cause audit; the language-neutral read-only source protocol is unchanged from iteration 028.
change_rule: No syntax, compiler, grammar, AST, checker, runtime, diagnostic, prompt skill, or benchmark instruction may change from iteration 028 output unless a signature recurs across unrelated repositories and independent sessions, then passes general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability review.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
stop_rule: Preserve the complete result without selective reruns. If strict parity and root-cause quality pass, preregister a larger confirmation before claiming parity. If either fails, make no same-corpus syntax or instruction change; only independently recurring general defects may enter separate design review.
